_comment: Profile schema v2: one file per Azure AD tenant. App Registration credentials sit at the top level; environments[] lists every Power Platform environment under this tenant. Switch environments at runtime with --env <name> or by changing defaultEnvironment. Copy this file to profiles/<tenant-name>.json and fill in real values. See .github/skills/configure-profile/SKILL.md for how to obtain each field.
tenantId: <Azure AD tenant ID, GUID, from Azure Portal > Entra > Overview>
clientId: <Application (Client) ID from your App Registration's Overview page>
clientSecret: <Client Secret VALUE (not the secret ID) — generated once, copy immediately>
refreshToken: <auto-filled after first run of /configure-profile — initial value: 'TODO'>
defaultEnvironment: <name of the environment in the environments[] list below, used when no --env is specified>

environments.name: <short name, e.g. 'dev' or 'ZAF Prod' — used to switch>

_app_registration_setup._note: If you don't have an App Registration yet, follow these steps in Azure Portal > Entra > App registrations > New registration
_app_registration_setup.account_types: Accounts in this organizational directory only (single tenant)
required_api_permissions: Dynamics CRM > user_impersonation (Delegated) — to call Dataverse Web API
Microsoft Graph > User.Read (Delegated) — to identify the user
Power Automate > Flows.Manage.All (Delegated, if available) — to create / update flows
Power Apps Service > User (Delegated) — to call PowerApps API for Swagger + connector data
SharePoint > AllSites.FullControl (Delegated, only if you'll work with SharePoint connectors)
_app_registration_setup.admin_consent: Required — click 'Grant admin consent' button in the API permissions page after adding the above
_app_registration_setup.secret_creation: Certificates & secrets > Client secrets > New client secret > pick 6-month expiration > save the VALUE column immediately (you can never see it again)
